answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are entered in ledge, expire in copper, and jade lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 135 aliases hence needs 47 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1298 identities would post 4945 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
